cautions.message: Figure 4 and Figure S6 heatmaps were opened and text-supported high-impact values were captured; the full heatmap matrices remain source-image evidence rather than normalized assay rows because they are not needed to close the missing-activity gate.
LS-AMP-F1 17% hemolysis at 200 µM is source-text supported. LS-AMP-E1 20% at 100 µM is preserved as a figure/database estimate, not an exact source table value.
ND values from Figure 2 are recorded as MIC_not_detected within the paper-tested concentration ranges rather than converted to numeric MIC values.
